style: cinematic 3D, Pixar-quality, dusty vest, hard hat, matte, deadpan slapstick
shot: vertical 9:16, camera always moving, size shifts wide to macro; pushes in on 2.1, 4.15, 7.6, wide on 9.0
character: PIGLET FOREMAN: businesslike pig, dignity to the last; back curves only in final beat
cast: BULL: large, necktie, stamp in hand, close to lens, never speaks. TWO BG PIGLETS: small, past the puddle, no hard hat or vest, building a lean-to, never near lens
props: form: ОДОБРЕНО stamp from hook, 2nd stamp at beat 7. brick: tagged, from wheelbarrow, rotated, set by ready row, thrown back in. trowel: from belt at drop-thud. wheelbarrow: in at beat 5, off at beat 9, crashes the puddle at 8.2. puddle, stick lean-to: from 0.0, sheds a branch when hit. ready row, gravel, bucket from 0.0. No on-screen text but stamp marks.
setting: bright sunny morning, open construction site; brick row by a poured foundation; gravel pile, bucket; puddle and branch pile where two piglets build a lean-to
lighting: bright morning sun, fully lit daylight

audio.language: Russian, verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: male, low chest voice ~130Hz, dry, businesslike deadpan, native Russian, @Voice: Sadachbia
audio.lip_sync: snout/jaw opens each syllable, his own voice, never a voice over

timeline.a: Hook: stamp swings past the lens, blacks out the frame; he staggers behind it, hard hat clacking
dry, deadpan; walks at the lens, chest fills the frame, form shaking in his trotters
no gap; stretch peaks, spine snaps straight, form flies up across the frame
Drops onto all four trotters, thud kicks dust, form slaps flat; grabs the trowel, smears mortar on the foundation
Wheelbarrow crashes in, bull brakes hard, shoulder-checks the piglet, muzzle huge at lens; flips the board, piglet grabs the tagged brick
flat disbelief; brick swings a full turn edge to edge across the frame, held at the lens
Brick fills the frame, drops away revealing the bull slamming his stamp on the form
Sets the brick beside the ready row, flush; bull grabs it, hurls it into the wheelbarrow, kicks it rolling toward the puddle; wheel clips gravel, grit sprays the piglet; he snaps the trowel up
flat and dry, eyes on the lens; wheelbarrow slams into the puddle mid-line, mud sprays across the frame, knocks a branch off the lean-to; line finishes by 9.0, trowel lowers in silence after
timeline.camera: push-in stays loose enough for the splash

timeline.a: Sits on the bucket, back curving first time, tracing its rim

must_appear: wordless tick-in-circle pictogram on the stamp; stamp crossing the lens at 0.0; brick filling the frame at 5.15; bull huge at the lens from 3.2; wheelbarrow splashing into the puddle on the final line
negative_prompt: night, dusk, lamp, dim, moody, low-key, dark scene; locked-off camera; bricks stacking, floating objects; duplicated brick, form, trowel or stamp; stamp leaving his hand; second bull, crowd, hands; background piglets speaking, near lens, or crossing the puddle; third piglet; background piglet in a hard hat or vest; tiered stick construction; cuts; easing before the crack-pop, stillness during the rise; slow speech, English, foreign accent; subtitles, watermark, text overlay, Cyrillic in frame, readable stamp text
motion_rule: EVERY second something large crosses or fills the frame: piglet, form, brick, bull, wheelbarrow, mud spray or camera; never a second where only the mouth moves
